code_hints: - After navigate, attempt to click the OneTrust accept button (#onetrust-accept-btn-handler) if present before querying PLP.
- If no a[href*='/product/'] found within ~3s on moncler.com, navigate to https://www.moncler.com/en-gb/men/outerwear/.
- On PLP, perform incremental scrolling (e.g., 6-10 viewport heights) and wait for network idle to load more items; collect unique anchors whose href contains '/product/'.
- Normalize any followed link to en-gb locale by rewriting the locale segment if needed before visiting the PDP.
- On PDP, wait for any of the price selectors provided; also capture title via h1 selectors.
- Consider a retry with a short wait if price is not immediately present, as Moncler pages are JS-rendered.
rationale: The failure occurred on the homepage, which is not a PLP and is often blocked by a cookie banner. We prioritize non-code changes by setting a stable PLP entry URL, adding a cookie-accept pre-action, and broadening PLP detection to anchors pointing to '/product/' which are consistent across Moncler PLP tiles. URL normalization ensures we stay on en-gb and avoid geo/brand detours (e.g., monclergroup.com) and locale traps. PDP selectors include multiple robust fallbacks for dynamic rendering.
